title: Levers and the Force-Distance Trade

serves.summary: The learner places the fulcrum and the push on a lever so a small force lifts a heavy boulder a required height, which shows the trade between force and distance in a lever.

request.objective: Place the fulcrum and the effort so a small force lifts a heavy load, and explain the trade between force and distance

problems.ask: Move the fulcrum so your push can lift the boulder.
problems.goal: The push needed is at most the strongest push: the fulcrum is at slot 1, 2 or 3.

problems.ask: Use your push to lift the boulder at least 24 cm.
problems.goal: The push is enough and the boulder rises at least 24 cm: the fulcrum is at slot 2.

problems.ask: Use your push to lift the boulder at least 36 cm.
problems.goal: The push is enough and the boulder rises at least 36 cm: the fulcrum is at slot 3 or 4.

problems.ask: You get no test push this time. Put the fulcrum where your push will lift the boulder at least 24 cm.
problems.goal: The push is enough and the boulder rises at least 24 cm: the fulcrum is at slot 2.
